subject: Can I use ggtree to draw a complicated tree image like this?

messages.author: 7199c55f446f6a46
messages.subject: Can I use ggtree to draw a complicated tree image like this?
parts:
Dear developer,

I plan to draw some phylogenetic trees with some phosphorylated site expression data. As shown below, the amount of different expressed sites (Up and Down) are displayed outside the main tree.

I have little experience in ggtree. Would you please give me some suggestions or good examples? Thanks.


Best,


Xiangchen Li

ggtreeExtra is your friend :)

see documentation in https://yulab-smu.top/treedata-book/chapter10.html
